text:
support-oncall: Escalation from customer (ticket #23489) — they started seeing a burst of 5xx/504s around 13:01 UTC. Multiple API calls time out, p95 spike to ~12s. Customer says this started immediately after they rotated keys.

support-oncall: Quick logs pasted below (redacted):

```
ERROR gateway: request rejected tenant=acct-9472 reason=queue_full code=503
WARN batcher: enqueue latency high inflight=512 backlog=120 kv_miss=true
ERROR auth-proxy: token_refresh_failed tenant=acct-9472 status=401
INFO retry: client=acct-9472 attempts=3 last_status=401
```

eng-sre-alex: On it. Can someone confirm repro steps? Is this limited to one tenant or widespread?

cust-success-erin: Customer confirms single tenant (acct-9472). They rotated tokens and immediately started retrying failed requests from their side (no exponential backoff). They've forwarded a sample curl.

support-oncall: Sample repro they sent:

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"open-instruct-large","input":"<long prompt>...","max_tokens":1500}' 
# returns 504 after ~10s or 503 gateway
```

eng-runtime-satya: Looks like a continuous-batching backlog + auth churn. Hypothesis: token rotation caused a burst of 401s, client retried aggressively -> inflight duplicate requests -> KV cache misses (cold path) and batchers filled to depth limit. That results in gateway rejecting with queue_full 503.

eng-infra-maya: Correlating infra metrics — saw a spike of auth-service 401s for that tenant between 13:01:40-13:03:20. Gateway retry policy kicked in (client-side and gateway-side), we briefly hit per-tenant queue depth limit of 256 and global inflight high-water.

eng-sre-alex: Immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) apply per-tenant short-term ingress rate limit 2) lower batcher max_batch_size for tenant to reduce per-request KV pressure 3) enable prefix cache warmup for their model variant.

product-ops: Customer is on hosted API (not Dedicated). They need throughput restored fast; if we throttle too hard it'll impact their SLA but it's temporary.

eng-runtime-satya: I'll push a runtime config change: set tenant-acct-9472.batch_size=4 and tenant-acct-9472.max_inflight=64. Also enable prefix_cache=true for the model. This should reduce memory churn and dequeue pressure.

deploy-bot: issued command: `infractl apply --target=runtime --patch '{"tenant":"acct-9472","batch_size":4,"max_inflight":64,"prefix_cache":true}'`

deploy-bot: patch accepted, rolling to 3 batcher pods matching selector tenant=acct-9472 (pod restart: batcher-7a2, batcher-7a3, batcher-7a4)

eng-infra-maya: Also throttled the tenant at the gateway level: `gatewayctl throttle set acct-9472 rate=20r/s burst=40` — will hold for 15m and then auto-evaluate.

support-oncall: After changes, customer reports errors dropped immediately. p95 reduced from ~12s -> ~850ms within 90s. No more 503s observed in tail logs.

eng-sre-alex: Root cause summary (preliminary): token rotation triggered broad client retries without jitter/backoff. That created duplicate inflight requests hitting cold KV cache and long sequence lengths, filling the continuous-batcher queues and tripping per-tenant queue depth limits. Gateway responded with queue_full 503s/timeouts.

eng-runtime-satya: Follow-ups: 1) Add guardrails: detect rapid 401->retry loops and auto-slow clients (adaptive backoff) 2) Increase observability: per-tenant retry amplification metric 3) Add a soft-degradation path that serves smaller-context model variant when tenant queue depth exceeds threshold.

product-ops: We'll coordinate with customer success to recommend safer key rotation patterns and client retry strategies to the customer.

cust-success-erin: Noted. I'll update the customer with the mitigation steps we took and recommend exponential backoff + rolling key swap (rotate on a staging token first).

eng-sre-alex: Creating a follow-up ticket and postmortem. Triage owners: eng-runtime (Satya), eng-infra (Maya), support (oncall), cust-success (Erin).

support-oncall: Closing the active escalation in this thread; will re-open if customer sees recurrence. :white_check_mark:
